scope: Single-request single-token BF16 FFN producer-consumer dataflow; no batching
status: Round complete: reproducible ~0.5% BF16 decode gain from block-cyclic streaming, retained as isolated experiment; default production unchanged. Other spatial/collector candidates rejected for production.
precision: Original BF16 GEMV operands and FP32 accumulation, activation/residual/norm. WKV state stays FP32. Per-output K tile order stays 0..31; no reassociation, approximation, fast-math or activation precision change.
device: RyzenAI-npu6, XDNA2 eight columns, default power mode; same model/toolchain as spatial-w2-eight report

variants.stream: Four W1 produce 256 outputs at a time. Two pair collectors and one root collector serialize canonical channel order. Four W2 consume a 256-element FIFO; row-major weights are read K-major using strided DMA. Fourteen compute workers.
variants.packed: Same graph, W2 tiles repacked once on host at model load to [worker=4,K/256,local_row/16,16,256], allowing contiguous replay DMA. No decode-time weight packing or additional host transfers.
variants.interleaved: W1 worker j owns 256-output blocks j,j+4,...; W1 DMA selects these from unchanged canonical key weights. MemTile joins four 256-output blocks into each successive contiguous 1024-element activation chunk. W2 consumes eight chunks with four K tiles per chunk, in original per-row reduction order. Raw diagnostic DMA scatters worker-local rows back into canonical order. No collectors; eleven compute workers, same count as production.

collector_model_comparison.order: A/S/P/P/S/A; 8 prompt, 48 decode, 2 trials, 4 warmup; no compilation overlap
collector_model_comparison.decision: Reject both 3-collector graphs for production; ~205.85/203.82 vs ~198.73 ms/token.

trace.scope: All eight matrix cores captured across five serial diagnostic programs, not simultaneously. Pair2 failed joint routing with egress7/3/2; solo key2 via egress0 and value2 via egress2 passed. Key0/value0 has two valid captures. All captures pass numerical/shift/replay/guards and strict complete-marker analysis. Trace changes routing and can perturb waits. W1 includes activation producer backpressure; W2 includes later activation waits. Lock events do not distinguish weight FIFO from activation FIFO. DMA port0 activity is not full-channel bandwidth. Remaining cycles are not automatically compute; no all-array peak claim.
trace.diagnostic_fix: Direct MLIR event markers produced incomplete W2 windows (end before begin); moving the source marker behind acquire did not fix it. Out-of-line diagnostic C++ event calls gave complete windows. Initial incomplete traces are excluded, not repaired in the analyzer.

overlap_evidence.scope: Observed broadcast-synchronized trace timelines have a few-cycle tile skew. Value marker excludes zeroing. Vector-event counts are not FLOPs or DDR bytes.

trace.timer_reference: Pinned local mlir_aie/python/aie/utils/trace/__init__.py documents broadcast15 timer reset/start synchronization, with a few-cycle tile skew.

production_default: Untouched; all builds require isolated roots and refuse the default production directory.
limits: K-major experimental weights support sequential decode/prefill only; batch2/chunk4 rejects them before dispatch.
Spatial INT8 variants are not introduced. Existing W8A16 path remains unchanged.
This is an FFN subgraph prototype, not an integrated 32-tile full-layer graph or a measured hardware ceiling.

interleaved_model_comparison.short_order: A/B/B/A; 8 prompt, 48 decode, 2 trials per process
interleaved_model_comparison.long_order: B/A/A/B; 32 prompt, 96 decode, 2 trials per process
interleaved_model_comparison.scope: Fixed synthetic tokens, single request; sequential prefill; graph build and CPU weight packing outside measured decode; no overlapping compilation or NPU jobs. Two workloads are reported separately. Token samples in a process are not independent statistical trials.

host_stage_profile.scope: Single diagnostic process each, eight explicit input tokens; exclude first token. Host wall time includes compute, DMA, waits, PDI/program alternation, and profiling overhead. Not a pure program-switch measurement and not used instead of uninstrumented model benchmark.
host_stage_profile.unit: median ms per token, excluding first of eight input tokens
host_stage_profile.interpretation: The eight-W2 regression is localized mainly to ChannelMix (64.216 -> 74.8237 ms); block-cyclic streaming lowers it to 62.8812 ms. This does not isolate pure PDI cost from weight DMA or other waits.

decision: Keep the block-cyclic 4+4 / eleven-core FFN as a validated experiment and future dataflow basis. Do not switch production defaults for this small gain and decode-only packed layout. No claim of 8/16-worker universal optimum, full 32-tile layer integration or hardware ceiling.

reproduce.model_root: Keep bf16-channel-mix built locally; symlink every other production root child only when destination does not exist. Do not compile through production symlinks.

trace.compile: Use same streaming compiler and a distinct RWKV_XDNA_KERNEL_DIR for each diagnostic program.

remaining_work: No complete 32-compute-tile full-layer graph yet. Existing production has 14-core parallel attention projections, 31-core FP32 recurrence/BF16 output graph for non-initial layers, and a separate FFN graph.
Eight-way W1 and sixteen-way FFN are not validated here; simple independent streams exceed this graph’s sixteen shim MM2S budget without further supply/resource redesign.
No projection-to-WKV streaming change in this round; FP64/FP32-emulation and approximate math remain separate numerical questions.
No new quantization or INT8 spatial implementation. INT8 remains W8A16: INT8 weight codes and FP16-derived per-output scales, BF16 activation/MAC operands, FP32 sums and recurrent state.
Separate weight-FIFO stalls, activation backpressure and DMA/PDI costs with more selective instrumentation before extending workers, depth or fusion.
